$comment: Tools for each build. Our own words; Amazon links are plain search links built from `query` (no ASINs, prices, ratings or images). Rules add up: default, then category, archetype, category+archetype combos, hardware kinds, then tall pieces. `slugs` can add or drop tools for one piece. Checked by scripts/tools-check.mjs. Each tool's `why` list gives the one-line reason shown in the Tools window: the first entry whose `if` matches the piece wins (`if` keys: category, archetype, hardware = all of these kinds, anchors = the piece gets the wall-anchor kit); the last entry has no `if`. `must` tools are listed first; the wall-anchor kit joins them when a piece can tip.

tools.name: Hex key set
tools.note: Most boxes include one; a set with a handle is kinder to your wrist.
tools.query: hex key allen wrench set metric

why.text: Tightens the bolts and cam pins. A handled set saves your wrist.
Tightens the bolts. A handled set saves your wrist.
Turns the cam pins in. A handled set saves your wrist.

why.text: Drives the screws and sets the door hinges.
